_method: anthropics/skills -> skill-creator, description-optimization. ~20 queries per skill, half should-trigger and half genuine near-misses. Queries must be what a person would actually type: concrete, with paths and context, sometimes lowercase or sloppy. An obviously-irrelevant negative tests nothing -- the valuable ones share vocabulary with the skill and still need something else.
